title: An update on the molecular biology of glioblastoma, with clinical implications and progress in its treatment

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《An update on the molecular biology of glioblastoma, with clinical implications and progress in its treatment》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】This review aims to give a panoramic view of the last 3 years' findings in glioblastoma characterization, its heterogeneity, and current advances in its treatment.

evidence.text: This review aims to give a panoramic view of the last 3 years' findings in glioblastoma characterization, its heterogeneity, and current advances in its treatment.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《An update on the molecular biology of glioblastoma, with clinical implications and progress in its treatment》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Patients with GBM often have poor prognoses, with a median survival of ∼15 months.

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Several molecular parameters have been used to achieve an accurate and personalized characterization of glioblastoma in patients, including epigenetic, genetic, transcriptomic and metabolic features, as well as age- and sex-related patterns and the involvement of several noncoding RNAs in glioblastoma progression.

evidence.text: Patients with GBM often have poor prognoses, with a median survival of ∼15 months.

Several molecular parameters have been used to achieve an accurate and personalized characterization of glioblastoma in patients, including epigenetic, genetic, transcriptomic and metabolic features, as well as age- and sex-related patterns and the involvement of several noncoding RNAs in glioblastoma progression.
